### goto_options_removed

Source: https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/blob/@sveltejs/kit@3.1.1/packages/kit/messages/client-errors/navigation.md

## goto_options_removed

> The `goto(..., { noScroll: true, keepFocus: true })` options have been replaced by `reset: false`

[`goto`](https://svelte.dev/docs/kit/$app-navigation#goto) no longer accepts separate `noScroll` and `keepFocus` options. Pass `reset: false` instead, which preserves both the scroll position and the focused element:

--------------------------------

### Use reset: false with goto

Source: https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/blob/@sveltejs/kit@3.1.1/packages/kit/messages/client-errors/navigation.md

Replaces the removed `noScroll` and `keepFocus` options. Pass `reset: false` to preserve both scroll position and focused element during navigation.

```javascript
import { goto } from '$app/navigation';

await goto('/somewhere', { reset: false });
```

--------------------------------

### `$app/navigation` > `goto` options are updated

Source: https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/blob/@sveltejs/kit@3.1.1/documentation/docs/60-appendix/35-migrating-to-sveltekit-3.md

### `goto` options are updated

In addition to the new `shallow` option described [above](#$app-navigation-Changes-to-shallow-routing), various [`goto`]($app-navigation#goto) options have changed:

- `invalidateAll` is now `refreshAll`, to mirror the [above change](#$app-navigation-invalidateAll-is-deprecated-in-favour-of-refreshAll)
- `keepFocus: true` and `noScroll: true` have been combined as `reset: false`
- `replaceState` is now `replace`

--------------------------------

### Replace pushState/replaceState with goto for shallow routing

Source: https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/blob/@sveltejs/kit@3.1.1/documentation/docs/60-appendix/35-migrating-to-sveltekit-3.md

In SvelteKit 3, `pushState` and `replaceState` are deprecated for shallow routing. Use `goto` with `shallow: true` and optionally `replace: true` to achieve the same effect. The `state` object is passed to `goto`.

```js
const state = {};
import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
// ---cut---
// instead of this...
pushState('/foo', state);
replaceState('/bar', state);

// ...do this:
goto('/foo', { shallow: true, state });
goto('/bar', { shallow: true, replace: true, state });
```

--------------------------------

### `$app/navigation` > Changes to shallow routing

Source: https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/blob/@sveltejs/kit@3.1.1/documentation/docs/60-appendix/35-migrating-to-sveltekit-3.md

## `$app/navigation`

### Changes to shallow routing

For [shallow routing](shallow-routing), `pushState/replaceState` are deprecated in favor of [`goto`]($app-navigation#goto):

```js
const state = {};
import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
// ---cut---
// instead of this...
---pushState('/foo', state);---
---replaceState('/bar', state);---

// ...do this:
+++goto('/foo', { shallow: true, state });+++
+++goto('/bar', { shallow: true, replace: true, state });+++
```

A new `persistState: true` option will cause `page.state` to be reapplied following a page reload.

Shallow routing now triggers navigation hooks ([`beforeNavigate`]($app-navigation#beforeNavigate), [`onNavigate`]($app-navigation#onNavigate) and [`afterNavigate`]($app-navigation#afterNavigate)). You can filter them out by checking the `shallow` property of the object passed to those navigation hooks.

content.text:
The recipe list now has a search box that filters by title and keeps the term in the URL as `?q=`. `npm run check` passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings. I haven't run the app in a browser, so the live typing behavior is untested.

- **`src/routes/+page.ts`**: reads `q` from `url.searchParams` and does a case-insensitive title match. It returns `q` and the filtered recipes.
- **`src/routes/+page.svelte`**: typing in the box updates the URL and re-filters the list. A shared `?q=` link opens already filtered, with the box pre-filled. If nothing matches, it shows "No recipes match …".
- **`goto` options**: Context7 showed SvelteKit 3.1.1 renamed the `goto` options. I used `{ replace: true, reset: false }` (formerly `replaceState` and `keepFocus`/`noScroll`). That way typing doesn't add a history entry per keystroke or lose focus.
- **No-JS fallback**: the input sits in a `GET` form named `q`, so pressing Enter still filters the list without JavaScript.
